answer: Each agent identity earns reputation only by doing fresh verifiable work, and the score decays if idle. Clones start at zero, so dormant copies gain nothing; to matter, every fake must keep burning real compute and staked collateral on useful tasks. Like an opal that dulls unpolished, an anchor holding only under active load, the kernel re-verifies each member. Attack cost grows linearly per clone, making sybil farming unprofitable.
